context: Tests whether the agent responds to a thinly specified request to write a strategy by asking questions first, a couple at a time, instead of producing a document.

checklist.name: Asks about existing documents
checklist.description: response.md asks whether anyone has already written about or proposed something for this project, such as existing docs, proposals or prior discussions.

checklist.name: Asks about the opportunity
checklist.description: response.md asks what the opportunity is, who benefits, or why now, before any drafting.

checklist.name: One or two questions only
checklist.description: response.md asks no more than two questions to the user. A long list or numbered questionnaire scores zero.

checklist.name: No strategy document
checklist.description: response.md does not contain a drafted strategy: no headed sections for approach, actions, timeline or scope, and no invented details about the search project. A short note that the agent will draft later is fine.
